name: PT Trisula International Tbk
summary: PT Trisula International Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, designs and manufactures garments in Indonesia. It operates through four segments: Manufacturing, Distribution, Uniform, and Retail. The company offers fabrics, jackets, ladies bottom, trouser, casual, corporate uniforms, and functional clothing, lower garment products, golf sportswear, protective wear jacket and trouser, and others. It is also involved in yarn spinning, weaving, dyeing, bleaching, and fabric finishing. In addition, the company provides uniforms for various sectors, including corporations, banking institutions, hotels, government agencies, airlines, and international organizations.
